stemMd: What did the studio do in its catalogue?

options.label: B
options.textMd: It removed all information about recycled content.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It guaranteed identical colour in every tile.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It displayed only the most uniform tile.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It showed several tiles per batch and published test results.

explanationMd: The catalogue combined multiple visual samples with functional test results. This let customers see variation and assess performance separately. It avoided representing a whole batch by one unusually ideal example.

distractorRationale.d: The catalogue deliberately showed several examples.
distractorRationale.b: The passage concerns explaining the material honestly.
